place: Ranikhet Golf Course and Pine Woods
text:
Ranikhet (Kumaoni: Rānikhèt) is a hill station and cantonment town, near Almora Town in Almora district in the Indian state of Uttarakhand. It is the home of the Military Hospital, Kumaon Regiment (KRC) and  Naga Regiment and is maintained by the Indian Army.
Ranikhet is at an altitude of 1,869 metres (6,132 ft) above sea level, within sight of the western peaks of the Himalayas. Ranikhet is a Class IV town with a civic status of a Cantonment board.

--- Practical Travel Context (Wikivoyage) ---
Almora (अल्मोड़ा Almoṛā) is a hill station in the Kumaon region of Uttarakhand. 
The town is typical of crowded hill towns in northern India, but the natural beauty around it is astounding. Almora is called a town of temples. Situated in the centre of the town is the temple of Goddess Nanda Devi. The mountain is also visible from the nearby areas.
best_time: March to June (pleasant summer flowers) and September to November (crisp autumn views)
